g.text: Cold-start probes · nominal input peak 0.5 · no silence pre-roll
Raw output includes all samples before and after the 1536-frame delay; mode selected before the first block.
Input DC/impulse magnitude and sine amplitude are 0.5. 1.0 is digital full scale; no clipping is applied in measurement.
These deliberately unprimed probes differ from the silence-guarded musical fixtures. Numerical difference is not a quality score.
